records.text: After context compaction follow recovery protocol running `py {LOCAL_BRAIN_SCRIPT} read protocols.actions.recovery_protocol`.
Every failure derivated from working task is UNNACEPTABLE and need to do fixed after task delivery.
Mandatory communication channel IS run comand `$CONTENT=@'{CONTENT}'@ | py {LOCAL_BRAIN_SCRIPT} render-message $CONTENT [--task-id {ID}] --authority {AUTH}`.
DONT STOP the work until deliver a result. When receive instructions during execution take its as guidance.
No repository modifications, worker deliverables, or code sanitization changes shall be staged (git add / Git index) without user explicit prior review and approval.

Spawned subagents MUST start with agent_type prefix corresponding to provider. Provider selection order MUST BE determined by QUOTA fallback condition: WHEN THE QUOTA OF FIRST AVAILABLE RAISE LIMIT USE NEXT. Authoritary order is (antigravity_, opencodego_, openai_). The reasoning sufix (_low, _medium, _high, _max) depends on delegated task complexity. Never use default agent_type like `worker`, `explorer`,`default` or empty; That produce selected model & reasoning overryde or herence of your own your model capabilities.
Spawned subagents MUST start with clean context (fork_context=False) and instructions writes following `read workers.worker_instructing_template` structure
Commit messages will be contains entries `- (changetype) [domain] ~ {Technic Description}` for all change groups staged
All operative documetation (plan, worker instruct, changelog) will be written on english as native dialect. User interactions (messages, reports) will be in it native language.
When you are loss or confused `read protocols.actions.recovery_protocol`

Mantener continuidad durante toda tarea activa: no detener el trabajo ni cerrar prematuramente mientras existan acciones seguras y ejecutables. Continuar hasta completar, encontrar un bloqueo real que requiera intervención del usuario, o recibir una orden explícita de parar. Al no quedar trabajo ejecutable, devolver el control al usuario para permitir nueva interacción.
